title: Show HN: Rust but Lisp
summary: A project combining Rust's performance and type safety with Lisp's expressive syntax and metaprogramming capabilities, likely implemented as a custom language or DSL that brings Lisp-style macros and homoiconicity to Rust development.
problem_solved: Brings Lisp's powerful metaprogramming and code-as-data paradigm to Rust developers who want more expressive syntax and macro capabilities.
why_valuable: Combines Rust's memory safety and performance with Lisp's legendary metaprogramming power, potentially enabling new patterns in systems programming.
